coaching.headline: Akeron and Lt. Belica scored ten of thirteen enemy kills; the team won no fight, and the enemy took every Fangtooth, Mini Prime and Shaper.

flags.text: Akeron ran the damn game: 5/0/1, the most hero damage of all ten, zero deaths.
Duo-lane fight in the allied half went 0-3, Legion, Yin and Riktor down, and enemy Fangtooth followed.
Lt. Belica killed Argus twice on the mid lane outside any detected fight and took the mid outer.
Draft ran one tank and two divers, Feng Mao and Yin, into Steel and Aurora's double frontline.

focus.title: Starve Akeron and Lt. Belica
focus.action: Before each Fangtooth or Mini Prime, the team groups with Riktor first; Feng Mao and Argus give ground until Yin shows, and Feng Mao or Legion buys anti-heal for Akeron.

8.call: Lt. Belica killed Legion and Yin and TwinBlast killed Riktor before enemy Fangtooth fell. With three allies down, concede Fangtooth and hold the duo outer.

9.4.call: Akeron killed Yin and Feng Mao on the offlane in the allied half, and enemy Mini Prime followed. Against Akeron, back out of long trades before Awakened turns the duel.

14.7.call: Enemy Fangtooth came first; Feng Mao then killed Lt. Belica on the duo lane, Akeron killed Argus at the Fangtooth pit and TwinBlast killed Feng Mao in the enemy jungle. With Fangtooth already gone, back off the pit rather than trade two deaths for one kill.

19.1.call: Aurora killed Legion and Lt. Belica killed Riktor on the duo lane, the last two kills, after all three allied outer towers had fallen. Once the outers are down, group as five before any duo-lane fight.

19040746-5158-4e98-b9b8-1003c416492b: Zero kills, zero assists and 498 hero damage per minute against an own average of 843. When Riktor lands a pull or suppress, shoot that target at once.
Most minions of all ten at 230, yet this 106 objective damage was the team's entire total. When TwinBlast and Steel are both down, hit the duo outer.
81a238da-1e77-41f7-aa8a-7716e2737f9d: Akeron took first blood on the offlane and a late kill there outside any detected fight. When Akeron lashes to a wall, back off before the leap stun lands.
Scored the team's first kill, Lt. Belica on the duo lane, then died to TwinBlast in the enemy jungle seconds later. After a rotation kill, reset to the offlane.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Zero kills and zero assists left kill participation at nil, and 5 wards sat at half an own average of 10. Before each Fangtooth, fill the ward cap there.
Died in both lost duo-lane fights, to TwinBlast before minute ten and Lt. Belica on the final kill, on the game's lowest gold. When Legion can follow, use the suppress.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Took 26130 damage and healed 11972, both game highs, but dealt 406 hero damage per minute against an own average of 871. Once Aurora spends Hoarfrost, commit.
Aurora took both Fangtooths, both Mini Primes, the Shaper and all four Seedlings, plus 70 enemy-jungle minions to zero here. When Aurora shows on one side, invade the other.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Hero damage ran 441 per minute against an own average of 926, and CS 7.7 against 9.9. When Lt. Belica leaves mid, push the lane and take the river camps.
The only allied kill after the Shaper fell came here, on Lt. Belica on the mid lane. Once Seismic Assault is spent, trade into that cooldown.
Kill participation hit 100% of the team's two kills, the best on the team. When Feng Mao starts a pick, follow up.

matchup: The allied duo died twice before minute ten; TwinBlast and Steel finished with zero deaths.
The field puts this carry lane against TwinBlast at 51.8% over 2011 games.
build: Malady and Infernum are two of the 60.5% core; The Perforator, the third piece, never got bought.
Infernum's Cinder ignites at four Kindling stacks for max-health damage, and Furnace scales with enemy bonus armor.
eternal: Aion turns spell damage on heroes into gold and stacks mana regeneration on casts.
Aion has too few games to lead in this carry field; Knell, Lotus and Xyris are a toss-up at the top.
Philosopher with Perfection sits under the pair floor; Sacrifice with Arcane Resonance is the best Aion pair.
augment: Scorched Earth makes Frag Order, Saturation Charge mines and Orbital Sanction leave Napalm zones.
Scorched Earth is clearly the best augment in this carry field. Sound keep.
crest: Pacifier's Adrenalize dashes and empowers the next physical hit, recastable after a quick hero kill.
Pacifier ranks low in this carry field; Epoch and Witchstalker are a toss-up at the top.
improvement: Tainted Rounds is the suggested answer to Akeron's healing: basic-attack hits cut the target's healing briefly.
The Perforator completes the 60.5% core and ignores part of physical armor, useful into two enemy tanks.
Witchstalker over Pacifier trades the dash for a cleanse and a true-damage hit that heals.

matchup: Akeron took three of four kills on this offlaner, including first blood.
Akeron's Web Lash roots, knocks up and stuns, Consume pulls, and Crushing Maw and Consume both heal.
build: Sky Splitter's Rend adds current-health damage on basic attacks.
Forticus finished after the fourth and final death, so the armor and tenacity missed all four.
The 59.6% core of Omen, The Perforator and Solstice never made the build.
eternal: Thraex marks the last hero hit by a basic attack for more damage dealt and less taken.
Demiurge leans ahead in this offlane field; Thraex ranks second among Eternals with enough games.
Savage Strikes with Ferocity sits under the pair floor; Alpha's Court with Rallying Roar is the only pair past the floor.
augment: Imperial Duelist debuffs basic-attack targets: more damage dealt to and less taken from debuffed targets.
Imperial Duelist and Ichorous Glaive are a toss-up in this offlane field. Sound keep.
crest: Eviscerator's Rending Strikes grants attack speed, omnivamp and empowered basic attacks for a short window.
Eviscerator has too few games to lead here; Nex and Ortus are a toss-up at the top.
improvement: Tainted Blade is the suggested answer to Akeron's healing: any physical damage cuts the target's healing briefly.
Into Akeron the field buys The Perforator at 38% against a usual 24%.
Demiurge over Thraex trades the duel mark for bigger item stats and stronger item-effect damage.

matchup: Steel out-warded this support 7 to 5 and finished with zero deaths.
Steel's Shield Slam knocks up and stuns in an area, and Bull Rush is unstoppable.
build: Inquisition, the only finished item, adds magical armor into Lt. Belica's magical damage, and Psywave pulses on ability casts.
The 58% core of Forticus, Tainted Guard and Transference never made the build.
eternal: Nihil grants Doom stats, both armors included, while damaging heroes, growing after level-ups and takedowns.
Knell, Lotus and Idrisil are a toss-up at the top of this support field; Nihil ranks below.
From the Abyss with Adaptive Plating is the best Nihil pair; From the Abyss with Terror sits under the floor.
augment: Zap O' 9-Chains makes the next basic attack after an ability cast zap nearby enemies.
Zap O' 9-Chains leans ahead of Wanton Warden in this support field. Sound keep.
crest: Sanctification's Safeguard shields the support and nearby heroes and grants tenacity while the shield holds.
Reclamation leans ahead in this support field; Sanctification ranks third among crests with enough games.
improvement: Tainted Guard or Tainted Bastion is the suggested answer to Akeron's healing; Tainted Guard also sits in the 58% core.
Reclamation over Sanctification trades the group shield for a group cleanse into Lt. Belica's and Steel's stuns.

matchup: The field puts this jungle against Aurora at 48.2% over 259 games; Aurora finished 1/0/8 with 11806 healing.
Aurora's Hoarfrost roots and Cryoseism stuns.
build: Sky Splitter, the only finished item, adds current-health damage on basic attacks into Steel and Aurora's tank health.
Sky Splitter is one of the 58.5% core; Tainted Rounds and Onixian Quiver never got bought.
eternal: Marrow heals a share of hero damage, more at low health; Roses adds takedown gold.
Weald leans ahead in this jungle field; Marrow has too few games to lead.
Blood Bank with Roses is the best Marrow pair. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Storm of Salvation extends Windburn and adds missing-health healing on hit while active.
Energy Transfer leans ahead of Storm of Salvation in this jungle field.
crest: Liberator's active cleanses all debuffs and grants a short shield.
Pacifier leans ahead in this jungle field; Liberator ranks third behind Eviscerator.
improvement: Tainted Rounds is the suggested answer to Akeron's healing and the second piece of the 58.5% core.

matchup: Lt. Belica's Seismic Assault stuns and knocks up, and Neural Disruptor silences.
Of 7904 hero damage taken, 7036 was magical.
build: Combustion's Pyro adds damage to the target and nearby enemies on ability damage.
Combustion is one of the 59.4% core; Wraith Leggings and Azure Core never got bought.
eternal: Vesh turns ability damage on heroes into a damage-over-time; Mind Rot adds current-health damage.
Lotus and Satariel are a toss-up at the top of this midlane field; Vesh ranks below.
Lich with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Infinite Obliteration gives Synaptic Obliterator's projectiles infinite range, faster travel and a longer slow.
Infinite Obliteration leans ahead in this midlane field. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's Anima grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed.
Soulbearer is clearly the best crest in this midlane field. Sound keep.
improvement: Tainted Scepter is the suggested answer to Akeron's healing: magical damage cuts the target's healing.
Into Lt. Belica the most played core is Azure Core, Entropy and Wraith Leggings at 62.7%.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.5s of lockdown): Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Akeron Web Lash (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
ourKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
ourKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
ourKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Reaping Dash in, Hamstring twice to slow, Safeguard to block the key ability, then Earth Shatter to execute and recast on a kill
ourKits.winCondition: trade with Safeguard up and chain Earth Shatter executes and Reaping Dash cooldown resets in fights
ourKits.passive: unique hero takedowns permanently grant bonus physical penetration, and all his physical penetration is increased
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the Earth Shatter execute
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's Spellshield before committing your key CC; back off when low, since Earth Shatter executes and recasts on a kill; armor counters his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Riplash to pull a hero in, Shock Therapy to break their shield and silence, Electrocute aura for damage and a shield, then Skewer to suppress everyone in front of him.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Riplash and chain silence and suppress so the target cannot fight back while their cooldowns stay frozen.
ourKits.passive: Suspended Sentence: while his abilities immobilize or silence a hero, their cooldowns stop ticking.
ourKits.playWith: Burst that deletes his pulled or suppressed target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stay behind minions or spaced so Riplash cannot reach you, and fight while it is on cooldown. Tenacity shortens the chain, which also shortens the cooldown freeze.

ourKits.combo: Lash Kick in for the slow → Windburn for range and cleave → third-hit max-health damage and heal → Backlash to push away, Quelling Gale to stop projectiles
ourKits.winCondition: stick with Lash Kick, ramp Rising Storm attack speed and out-trade with Windburn's healing third hits
ourKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks from basics and Lash Kick grant attack speed
ourKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick off isolated targets
ourKits.playAgainst: Backlash reflects projectiles and Quelling Gale halts them, so use melee or ground effects while they are up; fight after Lash Kick is used, and buy anti-heal against Windburn

ourKits.combo: Ether Crystal pushes then implodes to pull enemies together, Dread Nova stuns the group, Particle Shredder homes in, then Synaptic Obliterator beams finish low targets
ourKits.winCondition: poke from long range, zone with Ether Crystal and land Dread Nova stuns into Obliterator beams
ourKits.passive: abilities apply Disintegration stacks that make further ability hits deal more damage
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect him while he channels Synaptic Obliterator
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova, his only stun; dive him during the Synaptic Obliterator channel when he is immobile, and keep health high since beams hit harder on missing health; magic armor blunts his damage

enemyKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
enemyKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
enemyKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
enemyKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
enemyKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
enemyKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
enemyKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Vortex Grenade slow → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate barrage
enemyKits.winCondition: weave abilities for Gunslinger triple-shots and keep Rocket Dash up by hitting heroes
enemyKits.passive: casting an ability grants attack speed and makes the next basic fire three times
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates space for him to keep shooting
enemyKits.playAgainst: Rocket Dash is his only escape and comes back faster when he hits heroes, so engage right after he uses it; Ventilate is a short channel worth interrupting

enemyKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
enemyKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
enemyKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
enemyKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

enemyKits.combo: Web Lash roots a hero or leaps from terrain to knock up and stun, Crushing Maw bites for damage and healing, Hellfire's Demon Eye stacks slows, then Consume pulls enemies into his maw to bite and execute
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Hunger to become Awakened, then win extended fights with Awakened damage reduction, armor shred and Consume executes
enemyKits.passive: dealing and taking damage builds Hunger for more healing; at max Hunger he is Awakened with damage reduction and empowered basic abilities
enemyKits.playWith: teammates with follow-up damage on his Web Lash root who can push targets into Consume execute range
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash and watch for him lashing to walls before the leap stun; stay out of the Consume cone while he is slowed pulling, and avoid long trades once he is Awakened; buy anti-heal for his Crushing Maw and Consume healing
